items.name: Code Review
items.description: Use when reviewing a pull request or diff: focus on correctness, edge cases, and clear feedback.
items.content:
## Goal

Review the current change with a senior-engineer lens.

## Checklist

- Correctness and regressions
- Edge cases and error paths
- Naming / readability only when it blocks understanding
- Tests covering the risky paths

## Output

- Short summary
- Ordered findings (severity → medium → nit)
- Concrete fix suggestions

items.name: Git Release
items.description: Use when cutting a release: version bump, changelog, tag, and publish checklist.
items.content:
## Goal

Ship a clean release without skipping checks.

## Steps

1. Confirm `main` is green and up to date
2. Bump version (Conventional Commits / package)
3. Update changelog with user-facing notes
4. Tag and push
5. Verify CI / publish artifacts

## Don't

- Force-push release tags
- Skip failing checks "just this once"

items.name: Draft PR
items.description: Use when opening a pull request: write a clear Conventional Commit title and test plan.
items.content:
## Goal

Open a reviewable PR with a strong title and test plan.

## Title

Use Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): …`, `fix: …`).

## Body

- Summary (why, not only what)
- Test plan checklist
- Screenshots when UI changes
